f3_program: observe(at("jade.money", "initial"), 38, "currency", source("Jade had $38"))
fraction_of(at("julia.money", "initial"), at("jade.money", "initial"), 1, 2, source("her sister Julia had half as much money she had"))

transfer("new_years_eve_gift_to_jade", "aunt", at("aunt.money", "current"), at("jade.money", "current"), "aunt.gift_to_jade.amount", source("On New Year's eve, their aunt gave each of them an equal amount of money"))

transfer("new_years_eve_gift_to_julia", "aunt", at("aunt.money", "current"), at("julia.money", "current"), "aunt.gift_to_julia.amount", source("On New Year's eve, their aunt gave each of them an equal amount of money"))
same(event_field("new_years_eve_gift_to_jade", "quantity"), event_field("new_years_eve_gift_to_julia", "quantity"), source("gave each of them an equal amount of money"))
observe(at("jade_and_julia.money.total", "new_years_eve"), 97, "currency", source("they had a total of $97"))
sum_relation(at("jade_and_julia.money.total", "new_years_eve"), at("jade.money", "new_years_eve"), at("julia.money", "new_years_eve"), source("they had a total of $97"))
query("value", event_field("new_years_eve_gift_to_jade", "quantity"))
assumptions: The pronoun "she" in Julia's comparison refers to Jade, and "each of them" refers to Jade and Julia.

f3_program: observe(at("company.cash_flow_hedges.amount_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_loss_income", "2018"), -7, "million_currency", cell("Amount recognized in other comprehensive (loss) income", "December 28, 2018"))

observe(at("company.cash_flow_hedges.amount_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_loss_income", "2017"), 10, "million_currency", cell("Amount recognized in other comprehensive (loss) income", "December 29, 2017"))

query("difference", at("company.cash_flow_hedges.amount_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_loss_income", "2017"), at("company.cash_flow_hedges.amount_recognized_in_other_comprehensive_loss_income", "2018"))
assumptions: Accounting parentheses in "$(7)" denote a negative value, and the table reports values in millions.
The requested change is an ordered difference rather than a percentage change.
The requested total requires converting the movie duration from hours to minutes, but that conversion is neither stated in the source nor available in the F3-v1 allowlist.

f3_program: collection("owen.turtles", "turtle", "owen", source("Owen bred 21 turtles"))
produce("owen_breeding", "owen", at("owen.turtles.count", "current"), 21, source("Owen bred 21 turtles"))
collection("johanna.turtles", "turtle", "johanna", source("Johanna has 5 fewer turtles than Owen"))
offset(at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), at("owen.turtles.count", "current"), -5, "count", source("Johanna has 5 fewer turtles than Owen"))
multiple(at("owen.turtles.count", "after_1_month"), at("owen.turtles.count", "current"), 2, source("After 1 month, Owen has twice as many turtles as before"))
remove("johanna_loss_after_1_month", "johanna", at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), fraction(at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), 1, 2), source("Johanna loses half of her turtles"))

transfer("johanna_donation_to_owen", "johanna", at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), at("owen.turtles.count", "current"), at("johanna.turtles.count", "current"), source("donates the rest to Owen"))
query("remaining_count", "owen.turtles", "current")
assumptions: The turtles Owen bred enter Owen's collection at the start of the narrative.
The final question refers to Owen's turtle count after the one-month changes and Johanna's donation.

f3_program: collection("jame.cattle", "cattle", "jame", source("100 head of cattle"))
add("cattle_purchase", "jame", at("jame.cattle.count", "current"), 100, source("Jame's buys 100 head of cattle"))
observe(at("jame.cattle.purchase_cost", "purchase"), 40000, "currency", source("Jame's buys 100 head of cattle for $40,000"))
percent_more(at("jame.cattle.feeding_cost", "current"), at("jame.cattle.purchase_cost", "purchase"), 20, source("It cost 20% more than that to feed them"))
observe(at("jame.cattle.member.weight", "current"), 1000, "pound", source("They each weigh 1000 pounds"))
observe(at("jame.cattle.sale_rate", "current"), 2, "currency_per_pound", source("sell for $2 per pound"))
query("value", "jame.cattle.profit")
assumptions: The possessive-looking "Jame's" identifies the person Jame, and "he" refers to Jame.
In the feeding-cost statement, "that" refers to the $40,000 cattle purchase cost.
